scope.kind: read-only existing-realm PostgreSQL inspection and local AAD decryption
scope.verified: Checks at most 500 metadata rows per business owner, 1000 origin references, and all pages of the authorized first fixture snapshot. Rejects forbidden body/secret field names and verifies encrypted refs AAD, page order, digest and manifest count. This is a bounded inspection, not an exhaustive scan of all stored rows.
Exact decimal positions 9007199254740992, 9007199254740993 and 9223372036854775807 survive signing/decoding, and another device is rejected.
A current-owner regular 0600 token file succeeds; 0664, a symlink, and a 4097-byte file fail closed without returning contents. All fixture bytes are non-secret synthetic values.

boundaries: No service was restarted and no public authentication/account write was performed. Temporary database mutations and deliberate gaps were confined to this suite's newly created databases, whose cleanup passed.
